description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Soft-archives an uncommitted draft or failed generation. Keeps its content and media; Restore is available in the Library Archive view. Repeating the call is safe. Refused (409) for ready, staged, scheduled or published content, or any posting queue, post or approval history. Needs write scope and the same owner/admin authority as Library archive. A brand-bound connection only reaches its own brand.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/content/{id}/archive.)
name: archive_content
title: Archive a draft
